description: A predicate \(A\) on natural numbers is computably enumerable if and only if it is the domain of some unary numerical partial recursive function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.enumerable_iff_domain (A : ℕ → Prop) :
  REPred A ↔ ∃ f, Nat.Partrec f ∧ ∀ (x : ℕ), A x ↔ (f x).Dom
